title: Upload WAV file and perform inference using Baseline ResNet-34
description: Verify that the user can upload a WAV audio file via the web dashboard, perform inference using the Baseline ResNet-34 model, and view correct classification predictions and visualizations.

steps.description: Navigate to the Next.js web dashboard page.
Upload a valid WAV audio file through the upload interface.
Select the Baseline ResNet-34 model for inference.
Trigger the inference process and wait for the API response.
Verify the inference API returns predicted class probabilities for the uploaded audio.
Confirm the frontend displays the waveform and spectrogram of the audio.
Confirm the frontend visualizes convolutional feature maps generated by the Baseline model.
Verify that the predicted class corresponds to a valid ESC-50 category.

title: Upload WAV file and perform inference using SE-ResNet-34 model
description: Verify inference with the SE-ResNet-34 model variant correctly processes uploaded WAV files and shows predictions and visualizations with inclusion of SE attention features.

steps.description: Open the web dashboard and upload a valid WAV audio file.
Select the SE-ResNet-34 model as the inference model.
Start inference and wait for the model response.
Check the returned class probabilities align with the input audio content.
Verify the waveform, spectrogram, and convolutional feature maps including SE module activations are displayed.
Ensure predictions exhibit improved accuracy over the baseline, if ground truth is available.

title: Model accuracy validation on ESC-50 dataset
description: Confirm that Baseline ResNet-34 achieves at least 82% accuracy and SE-ResNet-34 achieves at least 85% accuracy on ESC-50 validation set.

steps.description: Train Baseline ResNet-34 model with standard ESC-50 dataset and default hyperparameters.
Validate model accuracy on held-out test set is ≥82%.
Train SE-ResNet-34 model with identical settings.
Validate model accuracy on test set is ≥85%, demonstrating 3-5% improvement.

title: Validate SE-ResNet-34 faster convergence compared to Baseline
description: Verify that training logs and experiment metrics show that SE-ResNet-34 converges faster than Baseline ResNet-34 under the same configuration.

steps.description: Train Baseline ResNet-34 model and record epoch-wise training and validation losses.
Train SE-ResNet-34 model under identical conditions.
Compare convergence speed metrics to verify SE-ResNet-34 reaches target accuracy in fewer epochs.

title: Real-time inference latency testing on GPU
description: Measure and verify that the inference latency per audio sample on GPU remains within approximately 15 milliseconds.

steps.description: Deploy model (Baseline and SE-ResNet-34) on GPU-enabled environment.
Send multiple WAV audio samples of standard length to the inference API.
Measure inference latency per sample and verify it is approximately 15ms or less.

title: WAV upload with invalid or corrupted audio data
description: Check system behavior when users upload corrupted or unsupported WAV audio files to ensure proper error handling and user feedback.

steps.description: Attempt to upload a corrupted WAV file or a non-audio file with .wav extension.
Verify the system rejects the file upload and displays a meaningful error message.
Try uploading a WAV file with unsupported sampling rate or format.
Confirm system gracefully handles format incompatibility without crashing.

title: Frontend visualization components correctness
description: Validate that the waveform, spectrogram, model predictions, and convolutional feature maps components accurately represent respective data.

steps.description: Upload a known WAV audio file.
Trigger inference and load visualizations.
Verify waveform display matches audio amplitude over time correctly.
Verify computed spectrogram visuals correspond to expected time-frequency representation.
Check convolutional feature maps correspond to actual intermediate layer outputs of the selected model.
Verify model prediction probabilities and top-1 predicted class are accurately displayed.

title: Training pipeline logging and checkpoint persistence
description: Confirm that training jobs correctly log hyperparameters, metrics, and gradient histograms to Weights & Biases and TensorBoard, and persist checkpoints to attached volumes.

steps.description: Start a training job using ModalTrainingJob system with Baseline or SE-ResNet-34 config.
Verify hyperparameters, loss and accuracy metrics, along with gradient histograms, are logged on W&B dashboard.
Verify TensorBoard logs are correctly generated and accessible.
Confirm that checkpoints for models are saved to the mounted persistent storage.

title: Model export validation for .pt and .onnx formats
description: Ensure trained models can be exported in PyTorch (.pt) and ONNX (.onnx) formats and the exported models load and run inference successfully.

steps.description: Export trained Baseline and SE-ResNet-34 models in both .pt and .onnx formats.
Load the exported .pt models and perform inference on sample inputs verifying consistent predictions.
Load the exported ONNX models using ONNX runtime and verify inference outputs match expected classes.

title: Config-driven hyperparameter tuning functionality
description: Validate the ability to change training configurations (e.g., mixup augmentation, optimizer scheduling) via OmegaConf configs and confirm changes effect the training pipeline as intended.

steps.description: Modify training config file to enable/disable mixup augmentation.
Start training job with the modified config.
Verify training pipeline applies mixup to data augmentation as configured.
Change optimizer scheduler config parameters.
Confirm the learning rate scheduler behavior during training reflects the config changes.

title: Model selection switching in inference API
description: Test the user's ability to switch between Baseline and SE-ResNet-34 models in the frontend and ensure backend infers using the selected model accordingly.

steps.description: Upload an audio file in the frontend.
Select Baseline ResNet-34 and perform inference.
Capture and record predictions and feature maps corresponding to Baseline model.
Switch model selection to SE-ResNet-34.
Perform inference again on the same audio file.
Verify the predictions and feature maps differ and correspond to SE model processing.

title: Remote training job triggering and monitoring
description: Verify that training jobs can be initiated remotely using the ModalTrainingJob system and the training progress is accurately monitored via W&B and TensorBoard.

steps.description: Invoke ModalTrainingJob remote function to start a model training session.
Confirm the training job begins and downloads the ESC-50 dataset automatically.
Monitor training logs via W&B and TensorBoard; verify hyperparameters and metrics are updated in real-time.
Confirm checkpoint files are persisted properly on attached volumes.
